residency_requirement: Bank of Baroda account holder (Proposer); Indian resident
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Maternity optional cover with 12-month waiting; 36-month PED waiting. Specific procedures range from 90 days to 3 years.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Hospitalisation beyond 24 hours covered up to SI, subject to room/ICU caps
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Proportionate clause applies if room rent exceeds 1% of SI per day (does not apply to ICU).

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Domiciliary hospitalization and OPD treatment excluded.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH inpatient up to Sum Insured

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Up to Rs. 50,000 per policy year as Optional Cover (8% discount on premium if not opted)
maternity_coverage.notes: Max 2 claims during lifetime. 12-month waiting period.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Automatic cover from birth under mother's SI during maternity policy period

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Donor's hospitalisation expenses for organ harvest
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Excludes pre/post hosp of donor, organ acquisition cost, transport/preservation, complications.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Good Health Incentive (every 4th policy period, expense reimbursement)

room_rent_capping: Up to 1% of SI per day
icu_capping: Up to 2% of SI per day
copayment_trigger_notes: Optional 10% co-pay on each admissible claim (including optional cover), with 8% discount in premium.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Up to 10% of SI, max Rs. 40,000 per eye per year

permanent_exclusions: Massages / Steam Bath / non-AYUSH alt treatment
notable_exclusions_summary: PED 36 months. Co-pay 10% optional (with discount). No domiciliary / OPD / overseas. Maternity is optional with Rs 50,000 limit and 12-month wait. Hospital cash Rs 500/day max 5 days included.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA; 72-hour pre-notification for planned, 24-hour for emergency. 30-day submission for reimbursement. 15-day settlement (45 if investigation). Helpline 1800 345 0330.
